As a production worker, you will work on the production floor preparing high-quality meat products. Your tasks: - Seasoning, mixing, and vacuum-packing meat products - Working with veal and pork - Keeping the workplace clean and safe No experience? No problem! We teach you everything step by step.    Working hours: - Start time between 06:00 and 09:00 AM - Workdays are usually around 8 hours - Because we work with fresh products, flexibility is important You like working with your hands and making good products. As a production worker at Luiten, your work really matters.This job as a production worker is for you if: - You like working with your hands - You speak English or Dutch, so you can communicate well with your colleagues and follow work instructions - You are available full-time
